notes.title: Wishlist InSight Now on Steam!
notes.notes:
Hey gamers, I am super happy to announce that my new Horror Survival Game "InSight" is officially listed on Steam! 

Wishlist it now to support my upcoming title and subscribe to hear more news and updates leading towards release!

The current plan is to make the game available in 2024 and I will update you all soon!

Thank you, and I greatly appreciate all of your support and feedback!
